get.description: Reports whether the API can reach its database.

503.description: The database is unreachable or did not answer in 3 s

post.summary: Sign up with an email or a phone, and a password
post.description: Always answers `201`, whether or not the account exists. With an email there is no body and the user must verify it. With a phone the body holds a Telegram link that confirms the number or recovers the account.

201.description: Email: no body. Phone: a Telegram link

post.summary: Verify an email address with the link token

410.description: The token is unknown, used, expired or for another purpose

post.summary: Send a new verification email

204.description: Sent, or the address is already verified

post.summary: Log in with an email or a phone, and a password
Rotate the refresh cookie and get a new access token
post.description: Needs the `em_refresh` cookie and an `Origin` of the client or admin app.

401.description: Missing, unknown, expired or revoked cookie, or reuse after 10 s

409.description: The cookie was used less than 10 s ago. Retry once

post.summary: Log out this session
Log out every session of the user
Request a password reset link
post.description: Answers the same whether or not the account exists: `204` for an email, `200` with a Telegram link for a phone.

200.description: Phone: a Telegram link that recovers the account

post.summary: Set a new password with the reset token
post.description: Verifies the email or phone the link was sent to, and ends every session.

410.description: The token is unknown, used, expired or for another purpose

post.summary: Change the password of the signed-in user
Add a phone number, or resend its confirmation link
post.description: Returns a Telegram link. The number is set on the account once it is confirmed in the bot.

409.description: Another account has confirmed the number (`already_in_use`), or this account already has a phone

post.summary: Add an email address to a phone account

204.description: Verification email queued (or an account-exists email)

409.description: The account already has an email

302.description: Redirect to Google, with the `em_oauth` state cookie

delete.summary: Unlink Google from the signed-in user

409.description: Google is the only sign-in method

get.description: Redirects to `<app origin>/auth/google`, with `?error=google_failed`, `google_email_unverified`, `google_account_in_use` or `google_already_linked` on failure. Never answers with JSON.

302.description: Redirect to the client or admin app

delete.description: Needs `password` for accounts with one. A Google-only account must have signed in within the last 5 minutes.

get.description: Owned and shared devices with the caller role, oldest first.

200.description: Owned and shared devices, oldest first

post.summary: Create a device
post.description: Returns a pairing code valid for 30 minutes. At most 20 devices per owner.

404.description: Device not found or not accessible

patch.description: Changing `ping_interval_s` increments the desired settings version. `offline_timeout_s` must be at least twice `ping_interval_s`.

403.description: `forbidden`: only the device owner can do this

404.description: Device not found or not accessible

delete.description: Removes its outages, diagnostics, memberships and queued notifications.

403.description: `forbidden`: only the device owner can do this

404.description: Device not found or not accessible

post.summary: Issue a new pairing code
post.description: Replaces any earlier code. The current device token keeps working until the new code is claimed.

403.description: `forbidden`: only the device owner can do this

404.description: Device not found or not accessible

post.summary: Invalidate the device token
post.description: The device gets `401` and needs re-pairing with a new code.

403.description: `forbidden`: only the device owner can do this

404.description: Device not found or not accessible

post.summary: Exchange a pairing code for the device token
post.description: Single use, valid 30 minutes. Case, spaces and hyphens in the code are ignored. Claiming replaces any previous device token.

404.description: Unknown, used or replaced pairing code

post.summary: Device check-in
post.description: `BOOT` or `PING`. Duplicates (same `boot_id`, `seq` not above the last) are acknowledged without changes. The `204` acknowledges the Wi-Fi events in the request.

429.description: More than 6 check-ins a minute, with `Retry-After`

get.description: Newest first. `from` and `to` keep outages that overlap the range (`from` inclusive, `to` exclusive). An open outage has `ended_at`, `cause` and `kind` set to `null`.

404.description: Device not found or not accessible

get.summary: List Wi-Fi and API reachability diagnostics
get.description: Owner only. Newest first. Times are estimated from the device uptime.

403.description: `forbidden`: only the device owner can do this

404.description: Device not found or not accessible

post.summary: Link the platform Telegram bot
post.description: Returns a link valid for 15 minutes. Pressing **Start** in the bot creates a channel and attaches it to every device you own. An earlier unused link stops working.

patch.summary: Rename, turn on or turn off one of my channels
patch.description: Turning a channel off sets `disabled_reason: USER`. A channel turned off after too many failures turns back on only through a successful test message.

404.description: Channel not found or not yours

409.description: Disabled after failures: send a test message instead

delete.description: Removes the channel with its device links and delivery log. Nothing is sent to Telegram.

404.description: Channel not found or not yours

put.summary: Set which devices send to one of my channels
put.description: Replaces this channel's device links. Every ID must be a device you own or view. At most 100 IDs.

404.description: Channel not found or not yours

post.summary: Send a test message to one of my channels
post.description: Sends a test message now. On success a channel disabled after failures turns back on. Limited to 5 per minute.

200.description: Sent; the channel after the test

404.description: Channel not found or not yours

409.description: The messenger did not accept the message

get.summary: Channels of mine that this device notifies

404.description: Device not found or not accessible

put.summary: Set which of my channels this device notifies
put.description: Replaces only your own links. Other users keep theirs. At most 50 IDs, and every ID must be one of your channels.

404.description: Device not found or not accessible

get.description: Owner first, then viewers by join time. Emails and phones are shown to the owner, and to each member for their own row.

404.description: Device not found or not accessible

delete.description: The owner removes any viewer; a viewer removes only themselves. Also detaches the member's channels from the device.

404.description: Device or member not found

post.summary: Invite a viewer by email or phone
post.description: Owner only. The link is valid for 7 days. An email invite is emailed; a phone invite returns `url` and is also sent by the Telegram bot when that number has an account that confirmed it. Inviting the same email or phone again replaces the earlier link. At most 10 viewers and pending invites per device.

404.description: Device not found or not accessible

409.description: Already a member, or the member limit is reached

get.description: Owner only. Expired invites are included, oldest first.

403.description: `forbidden`: only the device owner can do this

404.description: Device not found or not accessible

delete.description: Owner only. The invite link stops working.

403.description: `forbidden`: only the device owner can do this

404.description: Device or invite not found

get.description: No auth. Shows who invited whom to which device.

post.summary: Accept an invite
post.description: The account email or phone must match the invite. Joins the device as a viewer and attaches all of the caller's channels. An email invite marks the email verified; a phone invite needs an already verified phone. Accepting again returns the device.

403.description: `forbidden`: the invite is for someone else, or `not_verified`

get.description: Points at the newest published `STABLE` release, for flashing from the browser. Not cached.

404.description: No published release

get.summary: Factory image of a published release
get.description: Bootloader, partition table and app merged at offset 0. Published releases only. Cached for a day. Rate limit 20 / min per IP.

404.description: Unknown, draft or malformed version
